create_random_normal_samples: create random normal samples on a Euclidean manifold with configurable mean and standard deviation
generate_base_random_tensor: generate a base random tensor on the Euclidean manifold using the random alias method
compute_normal_log_probability: compute the log probability of a tensor under a standard normal distribution on the manifold
compute_base_log_probability: compute the base log probability of a tensor using the normal log probability method
compute_log_determinant_metric: compute the log determinant of the metric tensor which returns zeros for Euclidean space
